_what: The five channel-change flights of the house pigeon, generated in Higgsfield on 2026-10-05 at the owner's instruction ("use higgsfield to make a 4k better pigeon flying transition"; "4-5 is good of varying lengths but our mascot needs to be consistent in look"). Masters, start frames and the empty end frame are owner-local under output/Higgsfield Assets/Khajistan Flights 2026-10-05/. Every start frame was made with gpt_image_2_5 (4K, quality high) from the house reference Pigeon-Reference-4K.jpg on a flat grey (RGB 140) backdrop; every flight ends on the empty grey frame so the bird must leave the shot.

across.note: the website's wing wipe, remade: diagonally across and into the lens, a wing fills the frame, exits top right

approach.note: straight at the camera, passes over it

twirl.note: the owner's flamboyant swirling crossing, for a long tune

refused.kling3_0 4k twirl fd6cc694, swoop 5ae403: smoke-like smears behind the wings, a bird frozen in place for 1.5 s, and a body twisted into an S (spiral). Kling 3.0 renders straight flight well and acrobatics badly.
refused.kling3_0 4k across af0ec211, approach 65: wings held still through most of the shot; the kept takes beat.

credits: 491.75, measured: the Higgsfield balance read 1821.5 before the first generation and 1329.75 after the last (2026-10-05). An earlier estimate of ~330 in this file undercounted.
pipeline: render_flight.py: per-pixel backdrop plate (whichever of end-frames median and flight median is closer to neutral grey), alpha = (C-B).(F-B)/|F-B|^2 with F spread from the solid bird, colourless shadows dropped, colour premultiplied, Seedance plumage Lab-matched to the Kling bird (colour.json, gain capped 1.5), empty tail trimmed, a still-on-edge ending faded over 6 frames; HEVC with alpha at 2160 / 1080 / 720 (no 2160 from a 1080 source).
